FieldNotes.Comments: X array, no rotation. Site installed in field surrounded by forrest. Soil resembles soft dry mud. Wood boards covering electrodes. Single cow spotted within fenceline. Small stagnant creek 80m east, trending NS.Barb wire fence parallels creek. Standing water and mud puddles on approach. Batt LFP0674 (13.4 v). Mag cable NMC45.
